_note: Relative chronology of Velari sound laws. Dates are relative ticks on a draft internal timeline, not canon calendar years. A compound formed at date T evolves as separate words under every law dated before T, then as one word under every law dated T or later.

elder.description: Old Velari coinages: the great houses and the people-names.

middle.description: Coined after junction syncope but before apocope; the linking vowel survives (Vela-, Varna-).

scribal.description: Coined after the Thessari scribal reform; elements were already worn-down words, and scribes mark the junction with an apostrophe.

late.description: Coined after the dialect split; each dialect's later laws reach across the junction, and Union scribes write it with a hyphen (Vel-Surak).

scribal_reform.description: Thessari scribes begin marking compound junctions. Junctions formed on or after this date are written with an apostrophe.

union_hyphenation.description: Union scribes write post-split compound junctions with a hyphen and capitalize each element; informally the parts stand apart (canon Vel-Surak, alias Vel Surak).

laws.name: w-fortition
laws.description: *w hardens to v at the start of an element.

laws.name: j-hardening
laws.description: Element-initial *i before a vowel hardens to j (*iaksa > jaksa). Attested by canon Jasrek, Jaxx.

laws.name: t-aspiration
laws.description: *t becomes th at the start of an element before e.

laws.name: u-fronting
laws.description: *u fronts to y under primary stress.

laws.name: junction syncope
laws.description: Unstressed stem-final *a is lost before an internal boundary.

laws.name: hiatus elision
laws.description: Unstressed *a is lost before a vowel across a boundary (*dyra-isa > dyr-isa), so later coinages avoid vowel clashes.

laws.name: apocope
laws.description: Unstressed word-final *a is lost after a consonant in words of two or more syllables.

laws.name: rd-assimilation
laws.description: A word-final d after r assimilates to it (*syrda > syrd > syrr). Attested by canon Syrr.

laws.name: high-vowel gemination
laws.description: An element-final n after a high vowel doubles, compensating for the lost vowel.

laws.name: u-lowering
laws.description: Remaining *u lowers to o.

laws.name: cluster reduction
laws.description: Of a doubled consonant after another consonant, one is lost (*varn+nim > varnim). Scribal compounds joined later keep both, written across the apostrophe.

laws.name: ks-coalescence
laws.description: k before s becomes x (first half of *ks > x). Attested by canon Talyx, Virex, Jaxx.

laws.name: s-absorption
laws.description: s after x is absorbed (second half of *ks > x).

laws.name: x-gemination
laws.description: A word-final x doubles in a one-syllable word (*jaks > jax > jaxx). Attested by canon Jaxx.

laws.name: i-rounding
laws.description: i rounds to y before a geminate nn.

laws.name: proclitic elision
laws.description: The vowel of a proclitic is lost before the word it leans on.

sporadic._note: Irregular changes that strike some words and not others. Applied only in generation, to a seeded share of candidates, after all regular laws; every application is recorded in the trace. Never applied to the canon corpus. Draft.

laws.name: liquid dissimilation
laws.description: Of two r in a word, the later one becomes l (Varnkaras > Varnkalas).

dialects._note: Velari speech splits after the last common law. Canon: the Velari people are not the Imperium state; imperial, reformist and Union-aligned Velari coexist (species_velari.distribution). The branch laws and the split date are draft; the split is not yet mapped to a canon calendar date.

imperial.description: Court speech of the Imperium and its loyalist houses.

laws.name: velar unrounding
laws.description: y unrounds to i after k (Vel'kynn > Vel'kinn).

union.description: Reformist and Union-aligned speech, including Vel-Surak.

laws.name: s-degemination
laws.description: ss simplifies to s.

laws.name: o-raising
laws.description: Stressed o rises to u (*sorak > surak). Attested by canon Vel-Surak, a Union-aligned Velari world. Replaces a draft final th-stopping law that canon Daeryth (Union-aligned, ends in th) contradicted.
